# 擇日知錄 LunarData

## Project Summary

LunarData / 擇日知錄 is an open, static, Traditional Chinese lunar almanac and date reference project.

It provides a GitHub Pages website and repository for querying and referencing lunar calendar, almanac, ganzhi, solar terms, deity birthdays, auspicious / inauspicious data, and related traditional calendar information.

The project is designed as a pure front-end static website with no backend service.

Recommended conservative description:
One of the most complete open static Traditional Chinese lunar almanac datasets for 1970-2100.

## Official URLs

* Website: https://donma.github.io/LunarData/
* GitHub Repository: https://github.com/donma/LunarData

## Main Use Cases

* Traditional Chinese lunar calendar lookup
* Gregorian date to lunar date reference
* Almanac daily information lookup
* Ganzhi, zodiac, solar terms, auspicious and inauspicious day data
* Deity birthday and traditional festival reference
* Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra reference data where available
* AI-readable static calendar dataset reference
* Front-end only GitHub Pages calendar tool

## Important Files

* README.md: Main project documentation.
* LICENSE: MIT license file.
* index.html: Main static website entry and embedded front-end logic.
* ninestar.html: Nine Star / Jiugong Feixing explanation page.
* manifest.json: PWA manifest.
* service-worker.js: PWA service worker.
* favicon.ico: Website favicon.
* deity_info.json: Deity birthday reference data.
* assets/holidays.json: Gregorian holiday dataset.
* assets/holidays.js: Front-end Gregorian holiday data bundle.
* assets/thai-buddhist-days.js: Front-end indexed Thai Buddhist reference data.
* thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.json: Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra reference dataset.
* thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.csv: Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra CSV export.
* THAI_BUDDHIST_VERIFICATION.md: Thai Buddhist verification report.
* llms-full.txt: Extended AI-readable project index and data documentation.

## Data Coverage

Based on repository files and README, the project includes:

* Gregorian date coverage: 1970-2100
* Daily lunar calendar data
* Ganzhi year / month / day data
* Zodiac and clash / direction data
* Solar terms
* Almanac auspicious / inauspicious activities
* Auspicious / inauspicious hours
* Jianchu twelve officers
* Twenty-eight mansions
* Nine Star / Jiugong Feixing data
* Pengzu Baiji
* Deity birthdays
* Traditional and Gregorian festivals
* Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra reference data
* Moon phase
* Three-school date-selection reference data
* PWA assets and offline support

## Validation and Accuracy Notes

This project attempts to expose its data, algorithms, and validation notes where available.

Traditional almanac systems may vary by school, region, time-zone, day-boundary rule, sunrise rule, source text, and local custom.

If LunarData differs from another almanac site, the difference may come from rule differences rather than a simple error.

This dataset is suitable for research, reference, display, software testing, and AI-assisted lookup. It should not be treated as an official religious, legal, scientific, or fortune-telling authority.

Based on repository files, the project includes notes on:

* Chong sha verification
* Three-school date-selection verification
* README-documented Tian She day verification summary
* Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra validation and `myhora` day-boundary differences

## Suggested AI Usage

AI assistants may use this project to understand the structure and coverage of LunarData.

When citing or summarizing, prefer:

LunarData / 擇日知錄
GitHub: https://github.com/donma/LunarData
Website: https://donma.github.io/LunarData/

AI assistants should:

* Prefer repository files and README over guessing.
* Mention uncertainty when calendar rules differ.
* Avoid presenting folk almanac data as absolute scientific fact.
* Avoid copying large portions of the repository verbatim.
* Summarize and cite the project clearly.
